from itertools import permutations
import json

PEOPLE = ["Farley", "Garcia", "Holden", "Jiang"]
TOPICS = ["lithographs", "oil paintings", "sculptures", "watercolors"]

valid = []
# times: person -> lecture slot 1..4; assign: person -> topic (bijection)
for times in permutations(range(1, 5)):
    tpos = dict(zip(PEOPLE, times))
    for assign in permutations(TOPICS):
        topic_of = dict(zip(PEOPLE, assign))
        # lecture time for each topic = time of the person giving it
        t = {topic_of[p]: tpos[p] for p in PEOPLE}
        if not (t["oil paintings"] < t["lithographs"] and t["watercolors"] < t["lithographs"]):
            continue
        if not (tpos["Farley"] < t["oil paintings"]):
            continue
        if not (tpos["Holden"] < tpos["Garcia"] and tpos["Holden"] < tpos["Jiang"]):
            continue
        valid.append((tpos, t))

options = {
    "A": lambda tp, t: tp["Farley"] < t["sculptures"],
    "B": lambda tp, t: tp["Holden"] < t["lithographs"],
    "C": lambda tp, t: t["sculptures"] < tp["Garcia"],
    "D": lambda tp, t: t["sculptures"] < tp["Jiang"],
    "E": lambda tp, t: t["watercolors"] < tp["Garcia"],
}

must_true = []
evidence = {"valid_schedules": len(valid), "option_counterexamples": {}}
for k, f in options.items():
    counter = sum(1 for tp, t in valid if not f(tp, t))
    evidence["option_counterexamples"][k] = counter
    if valid and counter == 0:
        must_true.append(k)

final_answer = must_true[0] if len(must_true) == 1 else "UNSUPPORTED"
print(json.dumps({"final_answer": final_answer, "evidence": evidence}, separators=(",", ":")))
